description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of token routing within the FedHLM system, specifically for EDGE_P2P and LLM components. The chart contains four slices representing different categories. A large green slice, labeled “LLM”, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. A red slice, labeled “EDGE_P2P”, represents 3.9% of the total. Two smaller slices, colored blue and pink, represent 1.6% and 0.0% respectively. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is present, listing the labels corresponding to each color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise by decreasing proportion, with the largest slice positioned at the top.
